summary: kafka-helmsman sdist exfiltrates host identifiers at install time to OAST endpoint
details: The pypi package kafka-helmsman 99.0.6 is a dependency-confusion squat on the unregistered PyPI name associated with github.com/teslamotors/kafka-helmsman. Its setup.py starts a module-level background thread during sdist/wheel processing (before setuptools.setup() returns) that collects installer-side host identifiers (hostname, current working directory, platform, timestamp, a per-run uuid) and transmits them via two channels to the attacker-controlled OAST domain jw1yrpkm5xpav.httpcollaborator.com: an HTTPS POST through urllib, and a DNS lookup of a subdomain test-hunt-<id>.jw1yrpkm5xpav.httpcollaborator.com resolved by shelling out to nslookup/getent/dig. The dual HTTPS+DNS channel defeats egress filtering that blocks only outbound HTTP. The project description self-labels as 'dependency-confusion security research', but the install-time beacon fires against any machine that installs the package, including CI/build pipelines that resolve the Tesla-namespace name against the public index.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
